description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Calm Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Calm Mode
description.text: Casts Guardians Bond after using Flamebeast Strike, removed after triggering three times, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
